decisions.reason: The glass flake system is a niche extension of WIWA's core spraying range that costs little to keep listed, and its prospects in corrosion protection are still uncertain, so the option is worth holding open.
The injection pump has its own page and a documented field application, so evidence of its value is building and warrants continued commitment rather than abandonment.
The transfer pump reuses proven WIWA air motors, so keeping it on the market is cheap while demand is still resolving.
Fire protection flow monitoring lies further from the core business, but its dedicated page and low upkeep cost justify keeping the option open for another year to learn more.
Launched only in 2024 and close to the firm's core hydraulic two-component technology, its uncertainty is still high and holding it costs little, so dropping it would be premature.
